description: This file defines a custom Android View called Plot2DView that renders a 2D scatter plot of RadarPoint objects onto a Canvas. It includes methods for setting data points and drawing them as circles, scaling coordinates to fit the view's dimensions.

classes.name: Plot2DView
classes.description: A custom View subclass for rendering 2D scatter plots based on RadarPoint data, capable of scaling and drawing points efficiently.

methods.name: setPoints
methods.description: Sets the list of RadarPoint objects to be rendered and requests the view to redraw.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the default View drawing method to render the data points as circles on the Canvas, scaling coordinates to fit the view dimensions.
